full_judgment: 4. Mr. Md. Aftab Hossain, learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner purchased the landed property in suit on the basis of an agreement for sale on 27.02.1965 and got it registered through Court by the decree in the suit for Specific Performance of Contract and the petitioner entered into possession of the suit land, made improvement of the land by earth work thereby he has spent more than fifty thousand and planted fruit bearing trees and other trees on the suit land at a cost of TK.  10,000.00 more than 30 years ago; nor the trees have been grown up and value of the trees have been increased much which has not been considered by the High Court Division; that the case holding recorded in R.S. Khatian Nos. 47, 31 and 153 in the names of Haralal Ghose, Priolal Ghose and Jatindra Lal Ghose and Surendra Lal Ghose who entered! into an agreement with the petitioner on 27.02.1965 to sell their landed properties of the said holding in favour of the petitioner; they having failed to amicable execute and register the kabala in favour of the petitioner; he filed Title Suit No. 232 of 1970 in the Court of Madaripur for Specific Performance of Contract and the suit was decreed upto the appellate Court and accordingly the petitioner obtained a registered kabala in execution of the said decree through Court after 18 years on 04.08.1983 and as such it merits consideration whether such kabala comes within the mischief of the presumption. The learned Advocate further submitted that in the review petition no materials were produced showing that the petitioner is a co-sharer by inheritance and owning and possessing contiguous land in the suit and as such, the High Court Division without considering this aspect of the case has discharged the Rule illegally occasioning failure of justice.
